v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: The Lord is our God * Come, let us adore Him.

la: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.en: Let them know that the Lord is thy name.

r.la: Tu solus Altíssimus super omnem terram.
r.en: Thou alone art the most High over all the earth.

text.la: Suscitávit Dóminus * testimónium in Iacob: et legem pósuit in Israël.
text.en: The Lord set up a testimony in Jacob: * and made a law in Israel.

text.la: Coram pátribus eórum * fecit Deus mirabília.
text.en: The Lord did wonderful things * in the sight of their fathers.

text.la: Iánuas cæli apéruit * Dóminus, et pluit illis manna ad manducándum.
text.en: The Lord opened * the doors of heaven and had rained down manna upon them to eat.

text.la: Deus adiútor * est eórum: et Excélsus redémptor eórum est.
text.en: God is their helper, * and the most high God their redeemer.

text.la: Redémit eos * Dóminus de manu tribulántis.
text.en: The Lord redeemed them * from the hand of him that afflicted them.

text.la: Ædificávit * Deus sanctifícium suum in terra.
text.en: God built * his sanctuary in the earth.

text.la: Ádiuva nos, * Deus, salutáris noster: et propítius esto peccátis nostris.
text.en: Help us, O God, our Saviour, * deliver us: and forgive us our sins.

text.la: Ego sum Dóminus * Deus tuus Israël, qui edúxi te de terra Ægýpti.
text.en: I am the Lord * God of Israel, who brought you out from the land of Egypt.

text.la: Ne táceas Deus * quóniam inimíci tui extulérunt caput.
text.en: Be not thou silent, O Lord, * for Thy enemies lifted up their head.

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: May His loving-kindness and mercy help us, Who liveth and reigneth with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

benedictio.la: Deus Pater omnípotens sit nobis propítius et clemens.
benedictio.en: May God the Father Omnipotent, be to us merciful and clement.

source.en: Lesson from the book of Judith

text.la: 1 Cumque omnis exércitus decollátum Holoférnem audísset, fugit mens et consílium ab eis, et solo tremóre et metu agitáti fugæ præsídium sumunt, 2 Ita ut nullus loquerétur cum próximo suo, sed inclináto cápite, relíctis ómnibus, evádere festinábant Hebrǽos, quos armátos super se veníre audiébant, fugiéntes per vias campórum et sémitas cóllium. 3 Vidéntes ítaque fílii Israël fugiéntes, secúti sunt illos, descenderúntque clangéntes tubis et ululántes post ipsos.
text.en: 1 And when all the army heard that Holofernes was beheaded, courage and counsel fled from them, and being seized with trembling and fear they thought only to save themselves by flight: 2 So that no one spoke to his neighbor, but hanging down the head, leaving all things behind, they made haste to escape from the Hebrews, who, as they heard, were coming armed upon them, and fled by the ways of the fields, and the paths of the hills. 3 So the children of Israel seeing them fleeing, followed after them. And they went down sounding with trumpets and shouting after them.

body.la: Nos álium Deum nescímus præter Dóminum, in quo sperámus:
body.en: We know no strange God before the Lord. In Him we trust.

refrain.la: Qui non déspicit nos, nec ámovet salútem suam a génere nostro.
refrain.en: He despiseth us not, neither putteth He away His salvation from our nation.

verse.la: Indulgéntiam ipsíus fusis lácrimis postulémus, et humiliémus illi ánimas nostras.
verse.en: His mercy let us seek with tears, and humble our souls before Him.

benedictio.la: Christus perpétuæ det nobis gáudia vitæ.
benedictio.en: May Christ to all His people give, for ever in His sight to live.

text.la: 5 Misit ítaque Ozías núntios per omnes civitátes et regiónes Israël. 6 Omnis ítaque regio omnísque urbs eléctam iuventútem armátam misit post eos; et persecúti sunt eos in ore gládii, quoúsque pervenírent ad extremitátem fínium suórum. 7 Réliqui autem qui erant in Bethúlia, ingréssi sunt castra Assyriórum, et prædam, quam fugiéntes Assýrii relíquerant, abstulérunt, et onustáti sunt valde.
text.en: 5 And Ozias sent messengers through all the cities and countries of Israel. 6 And every country, and every city, sent their chosen young men armed after them, and they pursued them with the edge of the sword until they came to the extremities of their confines. 7 And the rest that were in Bethulia went into the camp of the Assyrians, and took away the spoils, which the Assyrians in their flight had left behind them, and they were laden exceedingly.

body.la: Dominátor, Dómine, cælórum et terræ, Creátor aquárum, Rex univérsæ creatúræ:
body.en: O Lord, Ruler of the heavens and of the earth, Maker of the waters, King of every creature,

refrain.en: Graciously hear the prayer of thy servants.

verse.la: Tu, Dómine, cui humílium semper et mansuetórum plácuit deprecátio.
verse.en: Thou, O Lord, unto Whom the supplications of the humble and meek are alway well-pleasing

benedictio.la: Ignem sui amóris accéndat Deus in córdibus nostris.
benedictio.en: May the Spirit's fire Divine in our hearts enkindled shine.

text.la: 9 Ióachim autem summus póntifex de Ierúsalem venit in Bethúliam cum univérsis presbýteris suis, ut vidéret Iudith. 10 Quæ cum exísset ad illum, benedixérunt eam omnes una voce, dicéntes: Tu glória Ierúsalem, tu lætítia Israël, tu honorificéntia pópuli nostri. 11 Quia fecísti viríliter, et confortátum est cor tuum, eo quod castitátem amáveris et, post virum tuum, álterum nescíeris, ídeo et manus Dómini confortávit te, et ídeo eris benedícta in ætérnum. 12 Et dixit omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
text.en: 9 And Joachim the high priest came from Jerusalem to Bethulia with all his ancients to see Judith. 10 And when she was come out to him, they all blessed her with one voice, saying: Thou art the glory of Jerusalem, thou art the joy of Israel, thou art the honour of our people: 11 For thou hast done manfully, and thy heart has been strengthened, because thou hast loved chastity, and after thy husband hast not known any other: therefore also the hand of the Lord hath strengthened thee, and therefore thou shalt be blessed for ever. 12 And all the people said: So be it, so be it.

body.la: Dómine Deus, qui cónteris bella ab inítio, éleva brácchium tuum super gentes, quæ cógitant servis tuis mala:
body.en: O Lord God, That breakest the battles from of old, lift up thine arm against the Gentiles, that devise evil against thy servants.

refrain.la: Et déxtera tua glorificétur in nobis.
refrain.en: And let thy right hand be glorified in us.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, univérsa nobis adversántia propitiátus exclúde: ut mente et córpore páriter expedíti, quæ tua sunt, líberis méntibus exsequámur.
text.en: O Almighty and most merciful God, of thy bountiful goodness keep us, we beseech thee, from all things that may hurt us; that we, being ready both in body and soul, may cheerfully accomplish those things that Thou wouldest have done.

office.title: Feria Sexta infra Hebd XIX post Octavam Pentecostes IV. Septembris
